label: Notification settings
text: This is a short demo of the Notification settings page in the sample app. An admin chooses the region and the channels the team is notified on. We are on a local sample, with test data.

label: Part 1 · Admin · 2 of 7
text: The dashboard shows 24 open orders and 3 of 4 notification channels enabled.

label: Part 1 · Admin · 3 of 7
text: In the top menu, click Notification settings.

label: Part 1 · Admin · 4 of 7
text: The region is North. We choose West, because the team moved.

label: Part 1 · Admin · 5 of 7
text: Tick Weekly digest. The counter says 4 of 4 channels enabled, and Save becomes available.

label: Part 1 · Admin · 6 of 7
text: Show advanced options opens the quiet hours switch. We leave it off.

label: Part 1 · Admin · 7 of 7
text: Save Changes. The green message confirms: Notification settings saved for region West.

label: Part 2 · User · 1 of 2
text: A regular user logs in on their own browser.

label: Part 2 · User · 2 of 2
text: Their dashboard shows the same counters, because the settings are shared.

label: Notification settings
text: That is Notification settings. The admin picks the region and the channels once, saves, and every user sees the result.
